title: How Much Can Repeated Running Buy? A Measured Variance Ceiling for LLM Code Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2606.00920v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A benchmark score is a measurement whose uncertainty has two sources: an aleatoric component from stochastic decoding and an epistemic component from the finite problem set. Using 16 models on 99 recent LeetCode-style problems with two prompts and five runs each (15,840 judged runs in a fully crossed design), we estimate both components and ask a design question: how much can repeated running buy? First, the pooled-binomial interval that repeated-run protocols invite answers neither question of interest---it is about $2\times$ too narrow for generalisation to new problems and $2\times$ too wide for the fixed problem set---and under correctly clustered intervals, 12 of 15 adjacent leaderboard pairs are statistically unresolved. translated_title: 重复运行能带来多少收益？LLM代码评估中实测的方差上限
translated_abstract: 基准测试分数是一种测量，其不确定性有两个来源：来自随机解码的偶然性成分和来自有限问题集的认知性成分。通过在99道LeetCode风格的题目上使用16个模型、两个提示词、每个配置运行五次（在完全交叉设计中共进行了15,840次评判运行），我们估计了这两种成分，并提出一个设计问题：重复运行能带来多少收益？首先，重复运行协议所采用的合并二项式区间无法回答任何我们关心的问题——对于泛化到新问题而言它窄了约2倍，而对于固定问题集而言它宽了约2倍——并且在正确聚类的区间下，15个相邻的排行榜名次对中有12个在统计上无法区分。其次，方差上限1+μ_w/σ_b²，即重复运行能够降低分数方差的最大因子，在各个模型中的中位数为1.34（范围1.05–1.71），因此重复运行能够缩窄置信……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过15,840次运行的完全交叉实验首次量化了LLM代码评估中的方差上限，发现重复运行最多只能将分数方差降低约1.34倍，且常用的合并二项式区间宽度存在约2倍的误差，导致排行榜上大多数相邻名次在统计上无法区分。
en_tdlr: Through a fully crossed experiment of 15,840 judged runs, this paper measures a variance ceiling for LLM code evaluation, showing that repeated running reduces score variance by at most a median factor of 1.34 and that the commonly used pooled-binomial interval is mis-sized by about 2x, leaving most adjacent leaderboard ranks statistically unresolved.
